create_handover_task: create a HandOver task instance with a specified object name like banana or pen
configure_handover_task: configure a HandOverTaskConfig dataclass with object model, container model, success threshold, and overlap boxes
get_reward_handover: get the reward signal from a HandOver task by checking object overlap with the container
initialize_episode_handover: initialize a new HandOver episode by placing the object and container props in the scene
get_instruction_handover: get the natural language instruction string for a HandOver task such as hand over the banana
